_comment: Walls: two short rubble columns (x7 top, x4 bottom) that never obstruct the open mid-band (y3-6), so entry->hearth->scouts->warren is always walkable. The x14-19 widening (#398-p2) is a WALLED gallery box -- y0-4 rim, y5-9 solid rock, painted with the cave biome's blocked tile (2,3) -- so the only way in is the three blockers on the x14 face and no reachable cell is empty.

floor_layers._pick: cave-floor variation reusing the cave biome's verified floor-tile neighborhood (same picks as sewers/cave_mouth).

entities.observe: A ring of fire-blackened stones, the ash inside long dead and cold. It lies in layers — lit, burned down, lit again, four or five times over.
entities.toast: A fire-pit ringed with blackened stones, gnawed bones banked around the edge and cracked open for their marrow. Nothing in the ash has been warm for a long time.

entities.observe: A midden of cracked bones, marrow sucked clean. They have been sorted by size, almost stacked. Gnoll, most of them; a few too large to name.
entities.toast: A heap of gnawed bones, splintered for their marrow. Some are Gnoll. One is a Drake's.

companion_source.taken_toast: The bones rise and fall into step behind you.

entities.observe: Old bones, settled where they fell. They are not going anywhere. Probably.

entities._comment: a Raskghar scout PAIR barring the way to the warren.
entities.observe: Two of them crouch where the tunnel narrows, moon-grey and mountain-shouldered, knuckles to the stone. Their small eyes track you without blinking. Behind them the tunnel keeps going down.

entities._comment: Reopened-gallery pair with dungeon_approach.gallery_seal_anchor. horns_delve_started requires post_game, whose backbone already includes cleared_the_warren/raskghar_sealed; this door cannot intercept first arrival or reached_the_warren.
entities.observe: The passage opens into a vast pillared gallery, its floor packed smooth by generations of pacing feet. Eyes catch your light far back in the dark and slide away. This is where they den, and where the big one waits, breathing slow in the black.

variants.toast: The gallery is silent now. The pacing tracks are old and dust-softened; nothing breathes in the dark ahead. Past the emptied den, the stone the Watch sealed stands unbroken.

visual_states.observe: Claw-gouges score the pillars, going quiet toward the back. The den is empty — cleared, then sealed.

entities.toast: The tunnel widens into a pillared gallery, the air stirring with breath that is not your own. Something large shifts in the dark ahead, and the pacing scuffs go quiet. You have found the warren.

door_when.open_toast: The gallery floor slopes down past where the den used to be. You come out in the delve's staging chamber.

entities._comment: Conditional field cameo only; the awakened_boss entity retains the Relc join/veto conversation and ally gate. b7 #201: seated at (11,4), brushing the walkthrough lane (11,5)/(11,6) so players can't walk past him unseen. b7 #203: absent arm — the descent window only; post-clear he is back at his permanent floodplains post (which carries the brother_in_arms stage).

dialogue.speaker: Relc
dialogue.text: There it is. Big one first. Questions after.

entities._comment: Conversation precedes combat. Join alone banks relc_joined_descent for ally_requires; solo never does. Victory banks cleared_the_warren, not raskghar_sealed; respawns=false. Balance: BOSS_CELLS gates warrior2+Relc 0.6-0.75; solo measured.
entities.observe: It fills the gallery mouth like a landslide that learned to breathe: upright, moon-grey, a pale mane over shoulders wider than a doorway. Old scars cross its hide, and a Gnoll's picked bones lie stacked at its feet. Its eyes hold on you with something worse than hunger: thought.

entities.once_per_waking_toast: You've picked this snare clean today. Nothing has been re-rigged since.
entities.skill_hint_toast: Sinew and bone hooks, strung low across the gallery floor. Trained hands would start with the hooks.
entities.locked_toast: Sinew and bone hooks, strung low across the gallery floor. You don't know how to spring it safely.

on_skill_use.toast: You work the hooks free of the sinew line and let it fall slack. Wedged in the rig: a couple of coins, old and green with tarnish.

entities.item_hint_toast: A sound pick could break the rubble. [Greater Strength] could shift the beam, or fire could take the tarred shoring.
entities.observe: Mortared rubble plugs the upper gap. One stone bears fresh pick marks.
entities.toast: The pick bites into the mortar. You clear a person-wide way through the rubble and keep the tool.

entities.observe: A fallen support beam jams the middle gap. It is intact and far too heavy to drag loose by hand.
entities.locked_toast: The beam will not move by hand alone. [Greater Strength] could shift it; a sound pick or fire opens another way.
entities.skill_hint_toast: Select [Greater Strength] and use it on the beam. A sound pick or fire opens another way.

on_skill_use.toast: [Greater Strength] — You lift the beam clear and roll it against the wall. The middle passage opens.

entities.observe: Tar-blackened shoring seals the lower gap. The timber is dry beneath the pitch.
entities.locked_toast: Tarred timber seals the lower gap. Fire could take it; a sound pick or [Greater Strength] opens another way.
entities.burn_toast: Fire runs through the tarred shoring. The timber drops to ash and leaves the lower passage open.

entities.observe: Shield Spider tracks run beneath the broken gallery and continue toward the lower tunnels.
A compact strongbox lies behind the nest, its brass clasp green at the edges.
entities.open_toast: The strongbox yields an old brass clasp, still carrying a steady protective enchantment.

entities.open_toast: The strongbox yields an old brass clasp, still carrying a steady protective enchantment.

entities._comment: Gates on the SHORING's own burn_counter, never the burns row's shared burned_the_debris -- sewers' debris banks that one, and this pocket is two maps away.
